description_en: Retrieves the proportions of HTTP status codes for an accelerated domain name at a 1-minute granularity
description_zh: 获取加速域名1分钟粒度的HTTP返回码占比
name: DescribeLiveDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain and that the caller has the required permissions on the domain name.
Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
多个域名之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). If both StartTime and EndTime are left empty, data within the last 1 hour from the current time is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 若StartTime和EndTime参数都为空，默认返回当前时间起1小时内的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). If both StartTime and EndTime are left empty, data within the last 1 hour from the current time is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 若StartTime和EndTime参数都为空，默认返回当前时间起1小时内的数据。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448109.html operation to obtain the ISP name
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448109.html接口获得
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region in English.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448109.html operation to obtain the region name
parameters.help_zh:
区域英文名。

通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448109.html接口获得
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between consecutive data entries. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔。单位：秒。默认值为60

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
